title: The Tangent Atlas forward tests: the Ken 11 and the Joe 10
description: Pre-registered, daily-updated forward tests of two personal indexes. The Ken 11: the 11 largest US companies by full market value (excluding Alphabet, Tesla and Meta), weighted by size and rebalanced quarterly, with its cash reset every two weeks to hold a chosen volatility. The Joe 10: the 10 largest US companies, Constant Weight, held at 15% volatility. Each is compared with SPY and with SPY plus cash at the same risk. Each model's rules and predictions are frozen in a release before its first day; later versions add results only. Hypothetical performance; not investment advice.
